claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha Portasound keyboard but not its condition, sound, or suitability for children.
Photo 0 left edge and photo 2 bottom left read YAMAHA Portasound.

risks.proof: Video clip of the keyboard being switched on with the display lighting up.
Video clip of every key being pressed and producing a note.
Audio clip of sound coming from the speaker grilles.

risks.risk: Power adapter or stand not included
risks.proof: Photo of the included power adapter and stand.

risks.risk: Age or year of manufacture unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the label showing manufacture date or serial number.
Photo of repair receipts or close-up of any patched areas.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and all keys producing sound
Photo of the label with model, serial, or manufacture date
Photo of any included power adapter and stand
response.reason: The witness identifies a Yamaha Portasound electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at its worst case; functionality, accessories, and age remain unproven.
